reason: I always get three quotes from local firms and go with the middle one. A one-man operation in Kuwait with no UK clients or reviews at £655 would probably be the cheapest quote, not the middle, so I'd likely use him as a price check and then hire someone in Manchester I can meet.
objection: 'Pay when happy' sounds nice, but what's the catch? If I'm not happy after two rounds, do I just walk away, or does it turn into an argument over 'out of scope' extras with someone I can't pop round and see? And who fixes it if he disappears after I've paid?
would_change_my_mind: Two or three real UK small business owners, ideally in Greater Manchester, I could message on WhatsApp who'd tell me he delivered and still answers after launch.
